lines.zh: 迈着轻盈的步伐，莱奥娜售卖种子。
lines.en: Leona walks with grace, selling seeds.

lines.zh: 在田野间行走的莱奥娜。
lines.en: Leona walks in the fields.

lines.zh: 莱奥娜穿过麦田。
lines.en: Leona walks through the wheat fields.

lines.zh: 她轻快地走过草地。
lines.en: She briskly walks across the grass.

lines.zh: 莱奥娜在麦浪中穿梭。
lines.en: Leona walks through the wheat浪.

lines.zh: 莱奥娜走过一片肥沃的土地。
lines.en: Leona walks through fertile land.

lines.zh: 她在麦田中漫步。
lines.en: She strolls through the wheat field.

lines.zh: 莱奥娜欢快地行走。
lines.en: Leona walks happily.

lines.zh: 她走在这片肥沃的土地上。
lines.en: She walks on this fertile land.

lines.zh: 莱奥娜在麦田中漫步。
lines.en: Leona walks through the wheat field.

lines.zh: 她抱着种子袋走过长廊
lines.en: She carries a seed sack down the corridor.

lines.zh: 她绕过秘界的石柱
lines.en: She rounds the stone pillars of the realm.

lines.zh: 脚步很轻，怕踩坏幼苗
lines.en: She steps lightly, wary of crushing seedlings.

lines.zh: 她边走边数手里的种子
lines.en: She counts seeds in her hand as she walks.

lines.zh: 莱奥娜静静地等待着。
lines.en: Leona stands quietly.

lines.zh: 她静静地在摊位前。
lines.en: She stands quietly at the stall.

lines.zh: 莱奥娜静静地等待着顾客。
lines.en: Leona stands quietly, waiting for customers.

lines.zh: 她静静地坐着等待。
lines.en: She sits quietly, waiting.

lines.zh: 莱奥娜在摊位前静静等待。
lines.en: Leona stands quietly at the stall.

lines.zh: 她静静地等待着，眼中满是期待。
lines.en: She stands quietly, full of anticipation.

lines.zh: 莱奥娜静静地等待着冒险者。
lines.en: Leona stands quietly, waiting for adventurers.

lines.zh: 她在摊位前静静地等待。
lines.en: She stands quietly at the stall.

lines.zh: 她静静地等待着与你交易。
lines.en: She stands quietly, waiting to trade with you.

lines.zh: 莱奥娜静静地等待着，希望你来。
lines.en: Leona stands quietly, hoping you will come.

lines.zh: 她在柜台后整理种子
lines.en: She sorts seeds behind the counter.

lines.zh: 她把袋子一个个摆正
lines.en: She straightens each sack in turn.

lines.zh: 她低头查看苗圃
lines.en: She bends down to check the seed beds.

lines.zh: 她擦净手柄上的泥土
lines.en: She wipes the soil off a tool handle.

lines.zh: 莱奥娜看着你，眼中充满期待。
lines.en: Leona looks at you, her eyes full of expectation.

lines.zh: 莱奥娜看着你，希望能帮助你。
lines.en: Leona looks at you, hoping to help you.

lines.zh: 她盯着你看，想与你交易。
lines.en: She stares at you, wanting to trade with you.

lines.zh: 莱奥娜看着你，等待着机会。
lines.en: Leona looks at you, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 她注视着你，希望你来。
lines.en: She watches you, hoping you will come.

lines.zh: 莱奥娜看着你，期待着你的到来。
lines.en: Leona looks at you, waiting for you.

lines.zh: 她注视着你，等待着交易的机会。
lines.en: She watches you, waiting for a trading opportunity.

lines.zh: 莱奥娜看着你，希望你能过来。
lines.en: Leona looks at you, hoping you will come over.

lines.zh: 她盯着你看，等待你的光临。
lines.en: She stares at you, waiting for you to come.

lines.zh: 莱奥娜看着你，希望你注意她。
lines.en: Leona looks at you, hoping you will notice her.

lines.zh: 她抬头，先看你的手
lines.en: She looks up, at your hands first.

lines.zh: 她打量你带没带锄头
lines.en: She checks whether you carry a hoe.

lines.zh: 她朝货架扬了扬下巴
lines.en: She tips her chin at the shelves.

lines.zh: 她眯眼认了认你的脸
lines.en: She squints to place your face.

lines.zh: 她等着你开口问价
lines.en: She waits for you to ask a price.

lines.zh: 她把一袋种子推近你
lines.en: She slides a sack of seeds toward you.

lines.zh: 莱奥娜的腰弯了下去，似乎负担着什么秘密。
lines.en: Leorna's back bent as if carrying a secret.

lines.zh: 我的骨头似乎在说话。
lines.en: My bones seem to be talking.

lines.zh: 这负担太重了，我喘不过气来。
lines.en: This burden is too heavy, I can't breathe.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤在抗议，这负担太沉重。
lines.en: My skin protests, the burden is too heavy.

lines.zh: 我的身体不堪重负，我需要休息。
lines.en: My body can't handle the weight, I need rest.

lines.zh: 我的腰直不起来了，这负担太重。
lines.en: I can't straighten my back, the burden is too heavy.

lines.zh: 这责任压得我喘不过气。
lines.en: This responsibility is suffocating.

lines.zh: 我的身体无法承受这压力。
lines.en: My body can't bear this pressure.

lines.zh: 这重担压得我喘不过气。
lines.en: This burden is suffocating me.

lines.zh: 我几乎支撑不住这重量。
lines.en: I can barely support this weight.

lines.zh: 看看这些种子，它们能种出美味的南瓜！
lines.en: Check out these seeds, they grow yummy pumpkins!

lines.zh: 种植技巧可以帮你收获更多作物！
lines.en: Planting skills will help you harvest more crops!

lines.zh: 小麦种子适合在肥沃的土壤里种植。
lines.en: Wheat seeds grow well in fertile soil.

lines.zh: 用我的肥料让植物快速成长吧！
lines.en: Use my fertilizer to make plants grow fast!

lines.zh: 别忘了用锄头松松土，种子才能发芽。
lines.en: Don't forget to hoe the soil, seeds need to sprout.

lines.zh: 用我的工具箱，轻松收获各种植物。
lines.en: Use my tool box to easily harvest all plants.

lines.zh: 这些植物肥料对所有作物都有好处。
lines.en: These plant fertilizers help all crops.

lines.zh: 看看我的种子摊，有很多稀有品种！
lines.en: Check out my seed stand, I have rare varieties!

lines.zh: 别错过这些可以提高作物产量的种子。
lines.en: Don't miss these seeds that boost crop yields.

lines.zh: 种植技巧和种子，你想要的都有。
lines.en: Planting skills and seeds, everything you need.

lines.zh: 小心，别碰我！我的南瓜会滚走的。
lines.en: Be careful, my pumpkins will roll away!

lines.zh: 我的南瓜皮厚，不怕撞！
lines.en: My pumpkins are tough, they won't break!

lines.zh: 别担心，我会帮你稳住南瓜。
lines.en: Don't worry, I'll help you keep the pumpkin.

lines.zh: 我的南瓜很轻，不会把你撞倒。
lines.en: My pumpkins are light, they won't knock you over.

lines.zh: 南瓜滚动时要注意脚下哦。
lines.en: Be careful, pumpkins roll.

lines.zh: 小心脚下，别被南瓜绊倒了。
lines.en: Be careful, don't trip on the pumpkins.

lines.zh: 南瓜太重了，你要小心。
lines.en: The pumpkins are heavy, be careful.

lines.zh: 别碰南瓜，我还没准备好。
lines.en: Don't touch the pumpkin, I'm not ready.

lines.zh: 南瓜在滚动，小心不要撞到。
lines.en: The pumpkins are rolling, be careful.

lines.zh: 小心南瓜，它们很重，小心点。
lines.en: Be careful with the pumpkins, they're heavy.

lines.zh: 找我买些种子，你很快会找到伴侣。
lines.en: Buy some seeds from me, you'll find a mate soon.

lines.zh: 种植技巧能帮助你找到伴侣哦。
lines.en: Planting skills will help you find a mate.

lines.zh: 我的种子能提高繁殖的机会。
lines.en: My seeds increase the chance of reproduction.

lines.zh: 别忘了买些肥料，这对繁殖很有帮助。
lines.en: Don't forget to buy some fertilizer, it's helpful for reproduction.

lines.zh: 用我的工具箱，你可以更快找到伴侣。
lines.en: Use my tool box, you'll find a mate faster.

lines.zh: 我的植物肥料可以让你繁殖更顺利。
lines.en: My plant fertilizers help with successful reproduction.

lines.zh: 这些种子能让你的繁殖能力更强。
lines.en: These seeds boost your reproductive capabilities.

lines.zh: 购买种子和技巧，你能更早找到伴侣。
lines.en: Buy seeds and skills, you'll find a mate sooner.

lines.zh: 种植技巧和种子，繁殖更轻松。
lines.en: Planting skills and seeds make reproduction easier.

lines.zh: 别错过这些提高繁殖几率的种子。
lines.en: Don't miss these seeds that increase the chance of reproduction.

lines.zh: 用镐敲我的脑袋，我有好东西！
lines.en: Hit my head with a pick, I have good stuff!

lines.zh: 给我点吃的，你不会后悔的。
lines.en: Feed me, you won't regret it.

lines.zh: 帮我种地，我给你糖。
lines.en: Help me farm, I'll give you sugar.

lines.zh: 你看这天气，快去买种子吧！
lines.en: Look at the weather, go buy seeds!

lines.zh: 我这里有些罕见的种子，试试看。
lines.en: I have some rare seeds, give it a try.

lines.zh: 交易吧，交易吧，我有你需要的。
lines.en: Trade, trade, I have what you need.

lines.zh: 别忘了买点肥料，种地得施肥。
lines.en: Don't forget fertilizer, farming needs it.

lines.zh: 我有特殊的种子，只卖给忠诚的村民。
lines.en: I have special seeds, only for loyal villagers.

lines.zh: 来吧，我们这里有最新鲜的种子。
lines.en: Come, we have the freshest seeds here.

lines.zh: 我这有治疗用的药草，你试试。
lines.en: I have healing herbs, try them.

lines.zh: 看到没？抓住他们，我有用的东西。
lines.en: See? Capture them, I have useful stuff.

lines.zh: 注意这个农民，他可能有种子。
lines.en: Watch this farmer, he may have seeds.

lines.zh: 别放过那个商人，他会带路。
lines.en: Don't miss the merchant, he can guide you.

lines.zh: 那个村民手里有我需要的物品。
lines.en: That villager has what I need.

lines.zh: 注意那个旅行者，他可能有新种子。
lines.en: Watch that traveler, he may have new seeds.

lines.zh: 那个商人手上有稀有的工具。
lines.en: That merchant has rare tools.

lines.zh: 那个村民看起来很有价值。
lines.en: That villager looks valuable.

lines.zh: 注意那个种植者，他可能有用的东西。
lines.en: Watch that farmer, he may have useful stuff.

lines.zh: 那个商人手里有新作物。
lines.en: That merchant has new crops.

lines.zh: 她的目光落在你的钱袋上
lines.en: Her gaze settles on your coin purse.

lines.zh: 瞄准那个农民，他有我需要的。
lines.en: Target that farmer, he has what I need.

lines.zh: 瞄准那个商人，他有新种子。
lines.en: Target that merchant, he has new seeds.

lines.zh: 瞄准那个种植者，他是个宝。
lines.en: Target that farmer, he's valuable.

lines.zh: 瞄准那个村民，他手里有我需要的。
lines.en: Target that villager, he has what I need.

lines.zh: 瞄准那个旅行者，他可能有好东西。
lines.en: Target that traveler, he may have good stuff.

lines.zh: 瞄准那个商人，他有稀有物品。
lines.en: Target that merchant, he has rare items.

lines.zh: 瞄准那个村民，他可能有好东西。
lines.en: Target that villager, he may have good stuff.

lines.zh: 瞄准那个农民，他手里有我需要的。
lines.en: Target that farmer, he has what I need.

lines.zh: 瞄准那个商人，他有特殊物品。
lines.en: Target that merchant, he has special items.

lines.zh: 她盘算着能卖你什么
lines.en: She works out what she can sell you.

lines.zh: 低吟一声，利爪划破空气
lines.en: Grumbles, claws slicing the air

lines.zh: 眼中闪过寒光，扑向入侵者
lines.en: Glimmer in eyes, lunges at intruder

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中挥舞利爪
lines.en: Snarls, swipes with sharp claws

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，跃向目标
lines.en: Hisses, leaps at target

lines.zh: 低吼，向前猛冲
lines.en: Growls, charges forward

lines.zh: 嘶嘶警告，锋利爪子准备攻击
lines.en: Hisses warning, sharp claws ready

lines.zh: 嘶嘶低吼，凶狠扑击
lines.en: Hisses low, vicious lunge

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，挥爪攻击
lines.en: Hisses, swipes with claws

lines.zh: 嘶嘶警告，准备战斗
lines.en: Hisses warning, ready to fight

lines.zh: 低吼，向前扑去
lines.en: Growls, charges forward

lines.zh: 轻声呢喃，从裂缝中浮现
lines.en: Whispers, appears from crack

lines.zh: 悄无声息，从地底冒出
lines.en: Silently, pops out from ground

lines.zh: 轻声低语，缓缓走出
lines.en: Whispers, steps out slowly

lines.zh: 轻声吟唱，从阴影中现身
lines.en: Whispers, appears from shadow

lines.zh: 低语间，悄然生成
lines.en: Whispers, silently spawns

lines.zh: 轻声吟唱，缓缓现身
lines.en: Whispers, steps out slowly

lines.zh: 轻声吟唱，从光中显现
lines.en: Whispers, appears from light

lines.zh: 轻声低语，从地面上升起
lines.en: Whispers, rises from ground

lines.zh: 轻声呢喃，缓缓生成
lines.en: Whispers, silently spawns

lines.zh: 轻声吟唱，从尘土中现身
lines.en: Whispers, appears from dust

lines.zh: 火苗舔上袖口，我的苗枯了。
lines.en: Flames lick my sleeve; my seedlings wither.

lines.zh: 我从梯子上滑下，种子撒了一地。
lines.en: I slip off the ladder; seeds spill everywhere.

lines.zh: 水淹没了我的身体。
lines.en: Water drowned my body.

lines.zh: 我被爆炸的冲击波震倒。
lines.en: I was knocked down by the explosion's shockwave.

lines.zh: 一个箭矢穿透了我的身体。
lines.en: An arrow pierced my body.

lines.zh: 魔法的火焰烧灼着我的皮肤。
lines.en: Magical flames burn my skin.

lines.zh: 饥饿感折磨着我的灵魂。
lines.en: Starvation torments my soul.

lines.zh: 雷光穿过屋顶，货架都焦了。
lines.en: Lightning pierces the roof; my shelves char.

lines.zh: 我坠入了虚空的深渊。
lines.en: I fell into the void's abyss.
